== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Algol''' is a trinary star system.
* The primary is a huge blue-white main sequence named ''[[Algol (star)|β Persei A]] / [[Algol (star)|Beta Persei A]]'', or ''[[Algol (star)|Algol A]]''.
* The secondary is turbulent orange subgiant named ''[[Algol (star)|β Persei B]] / [[Algol (star)|Beta Persei B]]'', or ''[[Algol (star)|Algol B]]''.
* The tertiary is a blue-white main sequence named ''[[Algol (star)|β Persei C]] / [[Algol (star)|Beta Persei C]]'', or ''[[Algol (star)|Algol C]]''.

{{TrinaryStarSystem

|primary        = B8 V

|tertiary       = A5 V

|SecondaryNotes = [[Astronomical Unit|Approximately 0.062 AU]] from the primary: unstable [[Flare Star|active star]] that is losing mass.

==== Notes ====
[[Algol (star)|β Persei A]] and [[Algol (star)|β Persei B]] are close companion stars. Stellar material is drawn off of the highly distorted, pear-shaped [[Algol (star)|β Persei B]] and falls onto [[Algol (star)|β Persei A]] due to the primaries high gravity. This process is called "mass transfer" and triggers enormous [[Flare Star|stellar flares]] on both objects. The stars emit intense [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|bursts of energy]], including X-rays and radio waves, that are generated by their powerful magnetic fields interacting with the mass transfer.

[[File:Binary Stars Mass Transfer.jpg|400 px]]

When observed from the surface of [[Terra]], the dimmer but larger [[Algol (star)|β Persei B]] happens to be at the correct angle to eclipse the slightly smaller but far brighter [[Algol (star)|β Persei A]] every [[Day|2.87 standard days]], causing [[Algol (star)|β Persei A]] to appear to have a variable luminosity. When the stars are observed from most other systems, the viewing angle is different and the eclipsing effect is not observed.

[[Algol (star)|β Persei C]] is a 4th-generation, metal-rich star but is otherwise considered unremarkable.

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]], orbiting [[Algol (star)|β Persei C]].
* x7 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
** Two orbit close to [[Algol (star)|β Persei C]], while the remaining five have circumtrinary orbits in the [[Outer World|far outer system]].
* x1 [[planetoid belt]], with a circumtrinary orbit in the [[Outer World|outer system]].
* x2 [[gas giant]]s, named ''Imper'' and ''Perv''.
** ''Imper'' is a [[Gas Giant|hot gas giant]] orbiting very close to [[Algol (star)|β Persei C]].
** ''Perv'' has a circumtrinary orbit in the [[Outer World|far outer system]].

=== Mainworld Data ===
'''Algol''' is an [[Asteroid Belt]] mainworld.

[[File:Asteroid Belt 01a3.jpg|600px]]

The Algol Belt orbits in the [[Inner World|inner system]] of [[Algol (star)|Beta Persei C]].
* It also lies within the [[Inner World|inner system]] of the [[Algol (star)|Beta Persei A]]-[[Algol (star)|Beta Persei B]] close binary pair.
* It receives very high levels of [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|stellar energy]].

[[File:Chart Orbit Inner Region Belt Simple.png|600 px]]

==== [[Planetary Size|Mainworld Size]] (S) ====
{{WorldSize|name= Algol|Size= 0}}

==== [[Atmosphere|Mainworld Atmosphere]] (A) ====
None of the bodies within the Algol belt retain an atmosphere.
* The belt is in [[Vacuum World|vacuum conditions]], requiring the use of a [[Vacc Suit]].
* {{TL|8}} or more advanced survival gear is required to settle this world.

==== [[Hydrosphere|Mainworld Hydrosphere]] (H) ====
The Algol belt contains no icy bodies. No belt objects are known to have frozen volatiles on their surfaces.
* Wilderness refueling is not possible within the belt.
* Water for the inhabitants is imported and is extensively recycled.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
[[File:Comp-Prog-Dav-R-Deitrick-Starter-Trav-Page-16 16-July-2018a.jpg|right]]
'''Algol''' is famous for its trinary stars: the huge bright primary, visible from the skies of [[Terra]], is nicknamed the ''Demon Star''. It has an eclipsing binary companion and is considered a textbook example of the principle of stellar mass-transfer.
* The primary is siphoning matter off its once much larger subgiant companion. Some astronomers like to call it a "star mugging".

The system's primary and secondary stars cause interference, strange tones and noises, and heavy static on [[Ship Sensor Suite|commo and sensors]].

The Algol Belt is the site of a scientific outpost, located on a large [[planetoid]] and funded by the government of [[Elysee (world)|Elysee]]. A bare-bones refueling [[downport]] and an occasionally occupied scientific observatory are maintained on ''Vert'', the [[Natural Satellite|major moon]] of the outer [[gas giant]] ''Perv''.

[[Solomani Security]] keeps a close eye on things to ensure the security of the [[Solomani Confederation|Confederation]] and the well-being of its loyal citizens. Almost anyone ''could'' be a [[Solomani Security|SolSec]] informant, passing on all sorts of useful information: some gain a reward or benefit for their actions, others are coerced, but many see it as an act of duty to help protect the [[Solomani Confederation|Solomani state]] and its interests.

==== World Timeline ====
Major events that have affected this world and the wider region that it lies within:

* [[-9235]]: far to [[coreward]], the [[Vilani]] discover [[jump drive]] technology. Over the centuries pioneers and settlers gradually spread across [[Charted Space]].
* [[-4045]] to [[-2204]]: the [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]] controls vast territories.
* [[-2431]]: [[Terran]]s discover [[jump drive]] technology.
* [[-2404]] to [[-2215]]: the [[Interstellar Wars]].
* [[-2204]] to [[-1776]]: the [[Rule of Man]] administers the former [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]].
* [[-1776]] to [[0]]: the [[Long Night]].
* [[0|The Year 0]]: to [[coreward]], the [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the {{Imperial}} [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[604]]-[[622]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]].
* [[624]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Express Boat Network]] is established.
* [[704]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is formed.
* [[800]]-[[820]]: the [[Psionics Suppressions]].
* [[871]]: the [[Solomani Confederation]] is founded.
* [[940]]: the [[Solomani Autonomous Region]] is dissolved.
* [[990]]-[[1002]]: the [[Solomani Rim War]].
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Second Survey]] includes data for the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
